_meta: Single source for /licenses.html. Every third-party library, dataset and service the site loads or credits belongs here, listed alphabetically within each category (scripts/ checks will enforce this). 'licenses' are keys into _data/licenseTypes.json, which holds each license's name and a link to its text. 'attribution' is present ONLY where the license or terms require a credit line, and mirrors what the map's attribution strip shows; public-domain sources are listed for transparency and carry none. 'toolId' links an entry to data/tools.json. Comparison-only tools use no data, so they are not listed. Rationale and ToU clauses live in docs/LICENSING.md.

categories.title: Flood & hazard data
categories.intro: Loaded live from each publisher's own server. Nothing here is stored or modified by this project.

items.name: BCDC Adapting to Rising Tides — Bay Shoreline Flood Explorer
items.note: Served via the Caltrans open data portal. Planning-level only. Displaying it as a live layer is fine; a redistributed copy of the dataset itself must stay share-alike.
items.attribution: Caltrans; BCDC Adapting to Rising Tides

items.name: BCDC East Contra Costa Shoreline Flood Explorer
items.note: Same program, WMS server and terms as the Bay explorer. Planning-level only.
items.attribution: Caltrans; BCDC Adapting to Rising Tides

items.name: Cal-Adapt Sea Level Rise – Coastal Inundation Scenarios
items.note: Flood-extent tiles for two models, mosaicked and served by Cal-Adapt (UC Berkeley Geospatial Innovation Facility). The CoSMoS component is USGS (public domain). Please cite the studies below.
studies: Barnard, P.L., Erikson, L.H., Foxgrover, A.C., Finzi Hart, J.A., Limber, P., O'Neill, A.C., van Ormondt, M., Vitousek, S., Wood, N., Hayden, M.K., & Jones, J.M. (2019). Dynamic flood modeling essential to assess the coastal impacts of climate change. Scientific Reports, 9, Article 4309. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-019-40742-z

Radke, J., et al. (2018). Assessing extreme weather-related vulnerability and identifying resilience options for California's interdependent transportation fuel sector. California's Fourth Climate Change Assessment, California Energy Commission, CCCA4-CEC-2018-012. https://www.energy.ca.gov/sites/default/files/2019-11/Energy_CCCA4-CEC-2018-012_ADA.pdf
items.licenseNote: No separate license stated by the tool

items.name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
items.note: Effective data only; preliminary maps are not shown. FEMA asks for acknowledgement.

items.name: Interagency Sea Level Rise Technical Report scenarios
items.note: Tide-gauge sea level projections from the Interagency Sea Level Rise Task Force (NOAA, NASA, EPA, USGS, USACE, FEMA, DoD), read live from the task force's Zenodo record (version 1.1). Values can differ from NASA's Interagency Sea Level Rise Scenario Tool.
studies: Sweet, W.V., Hamlington, B.D., Kopp, R.E., Weaver, C.P., Barnard, P.L., et al. (2022). Global and Regional Sea Level Rise Scenarios for the United States: Updated Mean Projections and Extreme Water Level Probabilities Along U.S. Coastlines. NOAA Technical Report NOS 01. https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/hazards/sealevelrise/sealevelrise-tech-report.html
items.attribution: Interagency Sea Level Rise Task Force, 2022 Technical Report data (Zenodo, CC BY 4.0)

items.name: NOAA Coastal Flood Exposure Mapper

items.name: NOAA High Tide Flooding stations
items.note: NOAA CO-OPS tide-gauge flood thresholds, from the Sea Level Rise Viewer's point-layer service.

items.name: NOAA Sea Level Rise Viewer
items.note: The sea-level-rise scenario overlay.

items.name: NOAA/NWS/NHC National Storm Surge Risk Maps
items.note: Hurricane storm surge overlay (Category 1–2, Southern California only).

items.name: USGS CoSMoS / Our Coast, Our Future
items.note: Served through Point Blue Conservation Science's tile/WMS infrastructure (geo.pointblue.org), which asks for a courtesy citation.

categories.title: Geo / demographic context layers
categories.intro: Non-flood layers you can overlay on the flood data, each loaded from the agency that publishes it.

items.name: California OPC State Sea Level Rise Guidance (2024), Appendix F
items.note: Median sea level rise projections for 14 tide gauges, hand-transcribed into the repository (site/_data/opcGaugeProjections.json) and used to compute the County Profiles timing table. The numbers are facts, not the guidance's text, and it states no license; cite the guidance.

items.name: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index

items.name: EPA Facility Registry Service
items.note: Regulated facilities.

items.name: EPA Smart Location Database

items.name: NOAA C-CAP land cover and Wetland Potential
items.note: Served through NOAA's Coastal Flood Exposure Mapper services.

items.name: NOAA Coastal County Snapshots (section text)

items.name: USGS The National Map — Structures
items.note: Critical facilities: hospitals, fire/EMS, police, schools.

items.name: U.S. Census Bureau — American Community Survey (5-year)

items.name: U.S. Census Bureau — 2020 tabulation blocks (TIGER/TIGERweb)

items.name: U.S. Census Bureau — LEHD LODES
items.note: County Profiles: jobs by workplace block (LODES8 workplace area characteristics, all jobs).

items.name: FEMA OpenFEMA — NFIP claims
items.note: County Profiles: National Flood Insurance Program claims and payouts by five-year period.
